events.title: US-Japan Coordinated Yen Intervention
events.description: US Treasury and Japan conducted rare coordinated yen-buying intervention. US 30yr yields highest since 2007. Japan using Fed FIMA repo. BOJ held at 1% on July 31. 30yr JGB yield at ~4%, 30yr high.

events.title: 2026 Iran War - Strait of Hormuz Crisis
events.description: Ongoing Iran war with periodic Hormuz closures. Iranian attacks on shipping for 5+ months. US sanctions on entities helping Iran. Iran conditioning reopening on 6 demands. Iran-Oman close to temporary transit route deal. Oil spiked above 100 in April, now retreating to mid-70s.

events.title: Israel Escalates Gaza Attacks Despite Trump Peace Plan
events.description: Israel escalating Gaza attacks, defying US-backed peace roadmap. Netanyahu: no withdrawal until Hamas disarmed. Trump announced disarmament plan July 31. Israel continuing strikes without prior warnings.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - WHO PHEIC Declaration
events.description: Ebola outbreak in DRC declared PHEIC by WHO May 16 2026. 4053 confirmed cases, 1850 deaths as of Aug 5. Spreading faster than response capabilities. Vaccine candidates entering clinical trials. Cases in Uganda.

events.title: France Fiscal Crisis - Eurozone Debt Epicenter
events.description: France H1 2026 deficit exceeds 107B EUR, 14.4% higher. Full-year deficit ratio potentially 8%. European sovereign debt market in upheaval. ECB rates unchanged July 23. Euro forward curve pricing 40bps hikes by end-2026.

events.title: China Property Crisis - 10 Quarters of Deflation
events.description: China in 10th straight quarter of falling prices. S&P expects home prices to fall further 1.5-2.5% in 2026. Property wealth destruction compared to US 2008. PBOC signaling stronger counter-cyclical support, moderately loose policy.

events.title: Argentina Country Risk Spike - IMF Payment Wall
events.description: Argentina country risk climbed to 451bps on Aug 7, highest since June. IMF principal payments due from Sept, ~3B for rest of 2026, doubling in 2027. Diplomatic crisis with Brazil.

events.title: 2026 Iran War Fuel Crisis Hitting South America
events.description: Fuel crisis from Iran war creating stark divide in South America. Oil exporters seeing windfalls, importers facing inflation and transport disruptions.

events.title: 2026 Mali Offensives - Coup Attempt
events.description: Mali government and Russia Africa Corps described attacks as coup attempt that was thwarted. Coordinated attacks renewed July 4 2026.

events.title: Emerging Asia Currency Defense - Won Surges 8.8%
events.description: Korean won surges 8.8% fastest since financial crisis. India lured 40B from diaspora via high-yield deposits. South Korea accelerating corporate dollar repatriation.

events.title: Fed Rate Hike Expectations Rising - 30% Probability
events.description: Fed held rates at 3.5-3.75% in July (9-3 vote). Markets assigning 30% probability to rate hike. New Fed Chair Warsh emphasizing inflation. Investors bidding up bond yields. Next FOMC Sept 16. US 30yr yields highest since 2007.

events.title: Nigeria Debt Crisis - 108B External Debt
events.description: Nigeria external debt over 108B. 130M citizens in multidimensional poverty. Diplomatic tensions with South Africa.

summary: Multiple cat-4/5 events active: US-Japan coordinated intervention, Iran/Hormuz war, Israel-Gaza escalation, Ebola PHEIC, France fiscal crisis, China property/deflation. Fed hike expectations rising to 30%.
